test_objective: Check that you can query entities based on a geoquery

test_cases.name: 019_01_05 Query several entities based on a geoquery
test_cases.doc: Check that you can query entities based on a geoquery
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/'
        method set to 'GET'
        Get Entities Request: and
    Query Parameter: entity_types set to '${entity_types_to_be_retrieved}' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/ld+json' and
    Query Parameter: georel set to 'equals' and
    Query Parameter: geometry set to 'Point' and
    Query Parameter: coordinates set to '[13.3986, 52.5547]'
}
